subject: Philomena Cunk
query: is philomena cunk a real person
title: Is Philomena Cunk a real person? Who plays her in Cunk on Cinema
answer: No. Philomena Cunk is a fictional character played by English comedian Diane Morgan. She is a deadpan, cheerfully clueless presenter in mockumentaries written by Charlie Brooker. The experts she interviews, however, are real people. Her new series, Cunk on Cinema, streams on Netflix starting Nov. 15, 2026.
body:
Cunk first appeared in 2013 on the BBC's "Charlie Brooker's Weekly Wipe." She went on to front "Cunk on Britain" (2018), "Cunk on Earth" (2022) and the special "Cunk on Life" (December 2024). Diane Morgan, born Oct. 5, 1975, in Farnworth, Greater Manchester, England, is also known for playing Liz in "Motherland," Kath in Netflix's "After Life" and for writing and starring in "Mandy."

In "Cunk on Cinema," Cunk tackles film history from the invention of the camera to AI. Charlie Brooker created the series with Morgan and leads the writing team. What's on Netflix lists 23 real interviewees, among them director Michael Bay, actor Benedict Cumberbatch, composer Daniel Pemberton, "Die Hard" screenwriter Steven E. de Souza, cinematographer Seamus McGarvey, critic Mark Kermode and physicist Jim Al-Khalili.

The joke of the format is that the experts answer her odd questions straight. The name is sometimes misspelled "Philomena Kunk" or "Cunk on Cinemas."
